ucs.comments: Granule cells relaying mossy fibre input as parallel fibres
ucs.requirement: Expand the head velocity context from [U.VN] under gain control by [U.GoC(golgi)] and send it to [U.PC(purkinje)].
ucs.requirementRealization: [U.VN] supplies head velocity, [U.GoC(golgi)] scales it, and the expanded code goes to [U.PC(purkinje)].
ucs.capability: Expansion recoding of mossy fibre input [Ito, 1982].
ucs.mechanism: Many granule cells each sample a few mossy fibres.

hypothesis.rationale: The FRG needs a context expansion stage before the Purkinje cells; the reviewed literature on the flocculus [Ito, 1982] does not state this role for its granule cells.

ucs.comments: Purkinje cells learning the VOR gain
ucs.requirement: Combine the context from [U.GC(granule)] with the error from [U.IO] and inhibit [U.FTN].
ucs.requirementRealization: [U.GC(granule)] gives the context, [U.IO] the error, and the corrected gain goes to [U.FTN].
ucs.capability: Supervised learning of the VOR gain [Ito, 1982].
ucs.mechanism: Climbing fibre input depresses co-active parallel fibre synapses.

ucs.requirement: Signal the retinal slip error from [U.VN] to [U.PC(purkinje)].
ucs.requirementRealization: The input from [U.VN] is turned into an error sent to [U.PC(purkinje)].
ucs.mechanism: Complex spikes report the retinal slip.

hypothesis.rationale: Olivary neurons are glutamatergic in the monkey [Lisberger, 1994]; no paper found reports the transmitter of the olivary neurons that project to the human flocculus.

ucs.comments: Golgi cells controlling the granule cell gain
ucs.requirement: Scale the granule cell gain from the input of [U.VN] and send it to [U.GC(granule)].
ucs.requirementRealization: The input from [U.VN] sets the inhibition sent to [U.GC(granule)].
ucs.mechanism: Golgi cell inhibition limits granule cell firing.

hypothesis.rationale: Golgi cells form a distinct inhibitory population of the cerebellar cortex in the cat [Eccles, 1967]; no paper found defines this population in the flocculus.

ucs.comments: Floccular target neurons in the vestibular nuclei

collections.comments: The floccular cortex is split into granule, Purkinje and Golgi cells, which differ in transmitter and projection target [Ito, 1982].
